PluginData.Author: Zeo-Corps
PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0.1 — Tactical HUD, ship status and shared fleet contacts.
PluginData.Description: Zeo Core 1.0.1 brings tactical ship markers, the TOS scope, ship and ammunition status, a friendly fleet roster, Battle Manager contact sharing, and a configurable HUD with draggable panels. Saves distress GPS waypoints from all received sectors, hidden from the game HUD by default. Includes the native Zeo settings menu and matching external overlay. Windows / Pulsar Legacy. Sharing requires compatible server telemetry and Battle Manager settings.
